'''Billy Hauser''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[April 2000 Williston Park tournament (29 April)]] on 29 April 2000, according to Brad Vogel's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d634">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-30-williston-park-new-york-4-29-00d634/ williston-park-new-york-4-29-00], DeckTech (Brad "Uncle Chall" Vogel, 30 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-30-williston-park-new-york-4-29-00d634/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
